beats.care: These athletes show what proper funding and coaching can do. Follow along: India's para athletes often win more than its Olympic squads.
beats.what: By Monday evening, India had 4 golds, 5 silvers and 2 bronzes at the Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, ranking fourth.
beats.why: Mona Agarwal won shooting gold with a Games-record score, and Nishad Kumar, Soumya and Rinku won athletics golds.

cards.body: Nishad Kumar took gold in long jump T47 in his first competition in that event. Rinku won javelin F46 gold with Ajeet Singh taking silver. Avani Lekhara won silver in air rifle.
China leads with 26 golds. Japan (27 medals) and Uzbekistan (23) are second and third.
cards.caption: China's medals so far

cards.body: Nishad Kumar, a high jump star, switched events and won long jump gold on debut.

cards.q: Do para sports get enough attention?

opts: 4 golds and a top-4 spot early on
cards.q: What makes India's Nagoya start notable?
cards.why: Four golds in the first days put India fourth, behind only China, Japan and Uzbekistan.

hook: 4 golds already in Japan. Can India *beat its 111-medal record*?

learn.t: India's best Asian Para Games haul is 111 medals, from Hangzhou 2022; it's chasing that in Nagoya with 168 athletes.

tldr: India had 11 medals, including 4 golds, and sat 4th at the Asian Para Games in Japan by Monday evening, led by Mona Agarwal's record-score shooting gold.
watch: The Games end on 24 Oct. Spill's prediction on whether India wins 100 or more medals closes then.
